card.name: Family and household possessive wording
card.fires_on: Words in advice or narrative about family life at home, such as 'their' or 'your' before belongings, drugs or children, and verbs like 'care', 'live' or 'gave' after family members. It fits personal and household settings.

modes.label: Possessives before household items
modes.description: 'your' or 'their' just before things a person owns or looks after.
modes.example: Properly store<< your>> drugs to prevent them from losing their effectiveness

modes.label: Verbs and nouns about family life
modes.description: Words like care, live, gave or go that follow family members such as children, wife or couple.
modes.example: you'll need to arrange for their<< care>> while you're in the hospital.

card.plain: It marks a spot in text about families and home life where a word about the household or personal care comes next.
